key_insight: LLM agents can help reproduce published findings and identify analytical choices that warrant expert review.
engineering_relevance: Executable reproduction baselines paired with automated robustness checks offer a practical workflow for auditing data-driven research.
method: Build SEER-Repro from 20 published cancer-registry studies and their reproduction resources.
Use an AI agent to reproduce atomic claims and generate executable analysis baselines.
Identify analytical choices, test defensible alternatives, and flag potentially consequential changes.
evidence_signal: The agent reproduced 77.4% of 2,190 atomic claims; the robustness pipeline flagged potentially consequential analytical choices in 9.5% of fully reproduced findings.
watch_item: Results come from one medical-registry benchmark, and flagged analytical choices require expert review rather than establishing that a finding is invalid.
paper_title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
